findings.claim: The correction prepends 'MCQ: ' or 'coding: ' to every objective id. Those 16 values are therefore no longer the repo-relative topic objective ids they purport to reference: zero of 16 resolves exactly to an objective in the topic manifests. This breaks referential integrity while trying to encode the format mapping inside an id string.
findings.recommendation: Keep each objectives entry as the exact '<course>/<module>/<topic>#<objective>' id. Represent format-to-objective coverage in a schema-supported field or structure from the separate tooling change; do not overload the identifier text with a display prefix.

items.note: The no-AI restriction now applies only to the 30-minute coding part, while the MCQ part explicitly defers any additional resource rule to the platform owner. This matches the frozen F3 block labels. A separate new high finding, sme-07, covers invalid objective identifiers introduced in the same blueprint correction.
The objective now distinguishes a merge commit for diverged histories from a fast-forward merge that only moves the branch pointer.
The objective now limits the execute-bit requirement to direct ./script.sh execution and contrasts interpreter invocation with bash script.sh.
